gloss: to accumulate; to store up; to build up

definitions.gloss: to accumulate; to store up; to build up
definitions.explanation: To gradually collect and store something over time, whether tangible (wealth, data) or intangible (experience, fatigue).

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{蓄積|ちくせき}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蓄積|ちくせき}してきた。
examples.english: I have accumulated years of experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蓄積|ちくせき}して⟦{分析|ぶんせき}する→分析する：25338_bunsekisuru⟧ことで、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{知見|ちけん}→知見：13695_chiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得|え}られる→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: By accumulating and analyzing data, new insights can be obtained.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蓄積|ちくせき}させないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休息|きゅうそく}→休息：02587_kyuusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}ろう→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: Let's take regular breaks so stress doesn't build up.

notes:
Emphasizes gradual, layered accumulation over time. Used in both positive contexts (knowledge, experience, wealth) and negative ones (fatigue, stress, waste). More formal than ⟦{溜|た}まる→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蓄積|ちくせき}→蓄積：14023_chikuseki⟧: accumulation of fatigue
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蓄積|ちくせき}→蓄積：14023_chikuseki⟧: accumulation of data
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蓄積|ちくせき}する: to build up knowledge
- ⟦{資本|しほん}→資本：03197_shihon⟧⟦{蓄積|ちくせき}→蓄積：14023_chikuseki⟧: capital accumulation
- {蓄積|ちくせき}された⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: accumulated experience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{溜|た}まる→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧: to accumulate, to pile up — more casual, often implies unwanted buildup
- ⟦{貯|た}める→貯める：27801_tameru⟧: to save up — focuses on deliberate saving, especially money
- ⟦{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねる→積み重ねる：06235_tsumikasaneru⟧: to pile up — emphasizes the layering process; often used for efforts or experiences
